remarks: Welcome to 30 Glenbrook Road, located in the heart of desirable Glenbrook. This 9th-floor apartment offers stunning views of the Long Island Sound and Stamford's skyline from a private balcony. Move right into this one-bedroom condo featuring newer floors throughout and plenty of natural light. The kitchen boasts quartz countertops, a subway tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. The spacious primary bedroom comfortably fits a king-sized bed--with two floor-to-ceiling double door closets. The bathroom has also been updated with subway tile and a newer vanity. Enjoy your morning coffee on the balcony while taking in the water views and enjoying ultimate privacy. All of this is just a short distance from downtown Stamford's many attractions, including great lunch spots like Rinaldi's Deli, pharmacies, and more. I-95 and the train station are also conveniently nearby--with dedicated parking for your car. Could this be the perfect investment property or starter home for you?
